schemaVersion1.description: Document schema version. Automation fails closed on unknown versions.

paperclipId.description: Lowercase RFC 4122 UUID (v1-v5) issued by the Paperclip host for companies, users, goals, agents, projects, revisions, evidence, and interactions.

phaseState.description: Derived phase state. The reconciler computes it and the plugin database checkpoints it. It never appears inside a Paperclip document, because a document revision binds both human confirmations and transition keys. See issue #8.
